title: Admin-to-Web Full System Sync with Reliable State & Error Handling

requirements.text: Fix the 'Reverting to Open' bug in shop status toggling: when the admin toggles shop open/closed status, the backend must persist the new status with an authoritative write (no optimistic-only update). The toggle must await backend confirmation before treating the update as complete. If the write succeeds, immediately invalidate and refetch the shop status query on both the admin panel and the website so the customer-facing view reflects the change without stale data.

quotes: Shop Status: When I toggle the shop status in Admin, the website must update instantly without errors.

Database Integrity: Every action in the Admin Panel (adding stock, changing status, recharge updates) must be written to the database with a high-priority 'Write' command to prevent the 'Reverting to Open' bug.

acceptanceCriteria: Toggling shop status in Admin saves the new value to the backend before the UI reflects success.
After a successful toggle, the customer-facing website shows the updated shop status (open or closed) within one query refresh cycle.
The 'Reverting to Open' bug no longer occurs after toggling closed — the closed state persists across page reloads.
The ShopStatusToggle component does not revert to the previous value unless the backend explicitly returns an error.

requirements.text: Ensure all admin write actions — including adding/editing product stock, updating order status, and submitting recharge orders — await backend confirmation before marking the operation as successful. Remove any fire-and-forget or optimistic-only patterns that can silently fail. Each mutation in useQueries.ts must properly await the actor call result and propagate errors to the calling component.

quotes: Every action in the Admin Panel (adding stock, changing status, recharge updates) must be written to the database with a high-priority 'Write' command to prevent the 'Reverting to Open' bug.

acceptanceCriteria: Adding or updating product stock in AdminProductList/AdminProductForm only shows success after the backend confirms the write.
Updating an order status in AdminPage only marks the order as updated after receiving backend confirmation.
Submitting a recharge order in MobileRechargeSection only closes the dialog and shows success after backend confirmation.
No admin mutation silently swallows errors or resolves prematurely.

requirements.text: Replace all fake or silent loading states on admin mutations with real error feedback. When any admin write operation (shop status toggle, stock update, order status change, recharge submission) fails, display a clear, visible error message (e.g., a toast notification or inline error text) stating what failed. Do not show a spinner or 'Updating…' animation that never resolves or never reports the actual failure to the user.

quotes: Error Handling: If a database update fails, show me a clear error message instead of showing a fake 'Updating' animation.

acceptanceCriteria: When a backend write fails, the admin sees a visible error message describing the failure within the same UI context (inline or toast).
The loading/spinner state is dismissed when an error occurs — it does not spin indefinitely.
The ShopStatusToggle reverts to the original value and shows an error message if the backend update fails.
All admin mutation onError handlers display a human-readable error string rather than swallowing the error silently.

requirements.text: Implement a global shop status polling or query invalidation strategy on the customer-facing website so that the shop open/closed state stays in sync with the backend. The website should refetch shop status at a short interval (e.g., every 30 seconds) and also refetch immediately on window focus, so customers always see the current status without a full page reload.

quotes: Shop Status: When I toggle the shop status in Admin, the website must update instantly without errors.
Perform a Full System Sync between the Admin Panel and the Website. Use a 'Global State' logic

acceptanceCriteria: The shop status query on the website has a refetchInterval of 30 seconds or less.
The shop status query refetches on window focus (refetchOnWindowFocus: true).
The ShopClosedBanner, CartDrawer checkout disable, and ProductCard Add-to-Cart disable all react to the refreshed shop status.
No stale open/closed state is shown to customers more than 30 seconds after an admin toggle.

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo — no new actor files.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Error messages shown to the admin must be in English.
nonGoals: WebSocket or real-time push — polling and query invalidation are sufficient.
Customer-facing error messages for backend failures (only admin-facing errors are in scope).
Redesigning the Admin UI layout or navigation.
Adding new admin features beyond fixing existing sync and error-handling gaps.
